title: Nirvana - Nevermind
summary: Landmark grunge rock album featuring 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' that propelled alternative rock into mainstream global youth culture.
facts: Produced by Butch Vig and recorded at Sound City Studios in Van Nuys, California.
Knocked Michael Jackson's 'Dangerous' off the top of the Billboard 200 chart in January 1992.
Certified Diamond by the RIAA with over 30 million copies sold worldwide.

title: Radiohead - OK Computer
summary: Masterpiece alternative rock album addressing consumerism, technology anxiety, transport paranoia, and 21st century alienation.
facts: Self-produced alongside Nigel Godrich in St Catherine's Court, a historic manor in Bath.
Featured tracks like 'Paranoid Android', 'Karma Police', and 'No Surprises'.
Consistently ranked among the greatest albums in rock history.

title: The Prodigy - The Fat of the Land
summary: High-octane electronic dance music / big beat album featuring 'Firestarter' and 'Breathe' that brought rave culture to stadium stages.
facts: Masterminded by Liam Howlett with vocals by Keith Flint and Maxim.
Debuted at number 1 on both the UK Albums Chart and US Billboard 200.
Iconic music video for 'Firestarter' featured Keith Flint in an underground tunnel.

title: Wu-Tang Clan - Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers)
summary: Groundbreaking debut hardcore East Coast hip-hop album produced by RZA featuring raw samples, kung-fu movie dialogue, and razor-sharp lyricism.
facts: Recorded at Firehouse Studio in New York on a micro-budget.
Launched the solo careers of RZA, GZA, Ol' Dirty Bastard, Method Man, Raekwon, Ghostface Killah, and Inspectah Deck.
Restored East Coast hip-hop's dominance during the early 90s G-funk era.

title: Spice Girls - Wannabe / Spice
summary: Global pop phenomenon album introducing 'Girl Power' and the quintet of Scary, Sporty, Baby, Ginger, and Posh Spice.
facts: Debut single 'Wannabe' hit number 1 in 37 countries.
Best-selling album by a female group in music history with over 23 million copies sold.
Pioneered global brand merchandising for 90s pop groups.
